summary: A posted bank reconciliation or cutoff run no longer blocks a follow-up run for the same account and month (its proposals are idempotent on their source reference). One open run per key stays enforced for every process; interest and recognition still allow only one posted run per month. No data changes.

preflight.name: the live-run index from migration 511 exists
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'uq_accounting_runs_live'

preflight.name: no key has two open runs (the new open index can be built)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT 1 FROM accounting_runs WHERE status IN ('prepared','approved','held','failed') GROUP BY community_id, process, period_month, coalesce(subject_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid) HAVING count(*) > 1) d

expected_changes: index uq_accounting_runs_live replaced by uq_accounting_runs_open (open runs, every process) and uq_accounting_runs_posted_once (posted interest and recognition runs).
No run, journal entry, reconciliation or statement changes.

verify.name: open-run index present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'uq_accounting_runs_open'

verify.name: posted-once index present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'uq_accounting_runs_posted_once'

verify.name: old live-run index removed
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'uq_accounting_runs_live'
